name: HG1000
description: The HG1000 is Hooga's full-body red light therapy panel — sized to cover a standing adult from head to hip in a single position. It delivers 660 nm red and 850 nm near-infrared wavelengths through 200 × 5W LEDs , producing an irradiance of 98 mW/cm² at 6 inches. At 1000W with a 35.8" × 8.2" footprint, the HG1000 is a common choice for people who want full-body coverage in the HG line. It ships with a door mount, hanging kit with adjustable pulley , and a built-in timer plus a carrying handle for easier movement. Who the HG1000 Is For The HG1000 is a good fit if you want a straightforward full-body panel without the higher price point of the PRO or ULTRA line. If you want higher irradiance per session, look at the HG1500 for more LEDs in the same series, or the PRO1500 for dual-chip technology and modular stacking. Download the Hooga HG Series user manual (PDF) Backed by a 3-year warranty and easy 60-day returns, the HG1000 gives you full-body coverage at HG-line pricing. Not sure which panel is right?
